recommended_pod.why: runpod-cpu5c-16vcpu is the D3 reference hardware, so the triage timings double as the D3 timing-calibration set (R6); 32 GiB holds three 9 GiB h=1.7 witnesses at once
recommended_pod.basis: calculix-smoke-3 (cpu3c, AMD EPYC 9654): native build + freeze + 2 controls in 233 s; pod CPU = 0.73 x local cgroup CPU (control-beam 56.5 s vs 77.5 s). Local triage CPU 5,947 s for 17 launches (relieved-tall-h1.7 extrapolated 1,540 s) -> about 4,300 pod CPU-s; 256 TRAIN h=3 primaries at estimate 11.06 local CPU-h x 0.73 -> about 8.1 pod CPU-h on 11 concurrent 2.5 GiB slots (largest geometry 77,514 nodes, estimate 2,004 MiB); local freeze of the 256 decks took 558 s

steps.name: f08-triage
steps.judges: 17 launches (8 primaries h=3, 6 witnesses h=2.25/1.7 on long-flexible, relieved-tall and nominal, 2 controls, 1 cold repeat) by f08_freeze --observe on the pod: C1 oscillator control (<= 1e-6 rel, <= 0.01 deg, unretained <= 1e-12), C2 Euler-Bernoulli beam control (static <= 2 %, f1 and second z-bending <= 1 %, crest <= 3 %, location <= min(2 Hz, 1 %)), M2 mode-ladder per primary, V1-V8 per witness ladder against h=1.7 (eigen <= 1 %, peak <= 5 %, location <= min(2 Hz, 1 %), phase <= 5 deg, curve floor, static <= 2 %, mass <= 0.5 %, asymptotic), V9 bank mesh pick, the cold repeat's worst-band tip compliance against its primary (reported), and per-launch pod CPU-s / wall-s / peak memory (D3, R6). Already observed locally on the Docker image: 16 of 17 PASS, long-flexible and nominal ladders PASS at h=3; relieved-tall-h1.7 (241,756 nodes) never finished locally and decides V9

steps.name: f08-train-bank-primaries
steps.judges: Gate: runs only if the f08-triage observation picked bank mesh h=3 (V9 PASS); otherwise the freeze refuses and nothing launches (refreeze the manifest at the picked h). Then the 1x TRAIN rung (R1: 256 public geometries, P law Q1, public seed 20261015, the first 256 of the nested 2048 TRAIN draw) at h=3, 48 modes, all three damping ratios: every launch COMPLETED, M2 mode-ladder per case, F2 sampling loss <= 0.5 %, and per-launch pod cost for the data-acquisition bill. References are served (case.dat about 1.2 MB each), not committed
